name: Wolfram (2,3) universality in Lean 4
onCreateCommand: curl https://elan.lean-lang.org/elan-init.sh -sSf | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain none && echo 'export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH' >> ~/.bashrc
postCreateCommand: export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH && cd ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/Proofs 2>/dev/null || cd ${containerWorkspaceFolder}; lake exe cache get && lake build
remarks: The Lake root is Proofs/ inside the paclet repository until the split of docs/PUBLISHING.md section 2 is decided; the postCreateCommand tries Proofs/ first and falls back to the repository root.
